The '''skuir fish''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]. They were aggressive, and grew to an average of five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="LoNH" />
